'''Scamp's boots''' were a type of [[brown]] colored footwear which were considered medium [[Armor/Legends|armor]] and worn during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] by [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]]. The [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Voidhound|Ace]] wore boots of this make when they delivered a shipment of guns to [[Drelliad village]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] for [[Rendia Freight]].

==Behind the scenes==
Scamp's boots first appeared as an item of medium [[Armor/Legends|armor]] in the Massively multiplayer online roleplaying game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' published by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. Players of the [[Smuggler/Legends|Smuggler]] class, the only class able to wear the boots, began the game wearing the armor making it one of the weakest pieces of equipment in the game. Apart from starting with the armor or trading it from another player in the game there is no other way to obtain Scamp's boots currently making it impossible for Imperial players to possess.
